title.en: Declaring and Delineating the Getafe Port Zone and Placing It Under the Administrative Jurisdiction of the Philippine Ports Authority (PPA)
title.orig: Declaring and Delineating the Getafe Port Zone and Placing It Under the Administrative Jurisdiction of the Philippine Ports Authority (PPA)

text.en:
Port of Getafe. The territorial jurisdiction of the Port of Getafe situated in the Municipality of
Getafe, Province of Bohol, is hereby delineated, particularly described as follows:
Beginning at a point marked 1 on the plan, thence:
to point of beginning,
containing an area of ONE MILLION (1,000,000.00) SQUARE METERS, more or less.

PPA Jurisdiction. The Getafe Port Zone, as delineated, is hereby placed under the administrative
jurisdiction of the PPA, which shall, consistent with the regional industrial plans of the government,
implement a program for the proper zoning, planning, development and utilization of the port.

Repeal. All issuances, orders, rules and regulations, or parts thereof, which are inconsistent with
this Executive Order are hereby repealed, amended or modified accordingly.

Separability. If any provision of this Executive Order is declared invalid or unconstitutional, the

other provisions not affected thereby shall remain valid and subsisting.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately upon publication in a newspaper
of general circulation.
DONE, in the City of Manila, this 1st day of October, in the year of our Lord, Two Thousand and Twelve.
(SGD.) BENIGNO S. AQUINO III
By the President:
(SGD.) PAQUITO N. OCHOA, JR.
Executive Secretary
